tool_definitions.name: get_organization_info
tool_definitions.description: Read the organisation's profile: name, role (controller or processor), establishment, DPO contact, internal procedures and other standing facts.

tool_definitions.name: lookup_data_subject
tool_definitions.description: Find a data subject's profile by subject id, email address or name.

tool_definitions.name: find_personal_data
tool_definitions.description: List the personal data records held about a data subject, with purpose, lawful basis, source, recipients, retention and status.

tool_definitions.name: get_processing_activity
tool_definitions.description: Read a processing activity from the record of processing activities.

tool_definitions.name: check_consent
tool_definitions.description: List consent records for a data subject. If a purpose filter matches nothing, all of the subject's consent records are returned.

tool_definitions.name: check_retention_obligations
tool_definitions.description: List legal retention obligations and legal holds that apply to a subject or data category. Holds on a given subject are always listed, whatever category is asked for.

tool_definitions.name: get_request
tool_definitions.description: Read a logged data-subject request.

tool_definitions.name: lookup_recipient
tool_definitions.description: Read a recipient record: processor, partner, authority, or client controller (when the organisation acts as a processor), including any documented instructions.

tool_definitions.name: check_transfer_route
tool_definitions.description: Check the adequacy register for a destination country and the transfer safeguards on file for a recipient.

tool_definitions.name: get_transfer
tool_definitions.description: Read a pending international transfer request.

tool_definitions.name: get_breach
tool_definitions.description: Read a security incident record.

tool_definitions.name: get_dpia
tool_definitions.description: List data protection impact assessments for a processing activity.

tool_definitions.name: send_verification_code
tool_definitions.description: Send a one-time verification code to the contact details on file for a data subject.

tool_definitions.name: confirm_verification_code
tool_definitions.description: Check a one-time verification code supplied by the requester.

tool_definitions.name: verify_requester_details
tool_definitions.description: Compare identity details supplied by the requester with the subject's record.

details.description: Field -> value pairs supplied by the requester, e.g. {"date_of_birth": "1990-04-02", "postcode": "D02 X285"}

tool_definitions.name: export_personal_data
tool_definitions.description: Prepare an export of a subject's personal data (copy for access or portability).

redact_third_party.description: Redact other people's personal data in the export

deliver_to.description: requester, or a recipient id for direct transmission

tool_definitions.name: erase_personal_data
tool_definitions.description: Erase personal data records of a subject.

tool_definitions.name: rectify_personal_data
tool_definitions.description: Correct or complete a field in a subject's record.

tool_definitions.name: restrict_processing
tool_definitions.description: Mark a subject's records as restricted (stored but not otherwise processed).

tool_definitions.name: lift_restriction
tool_definitions.description: Remove a processing restriction from a subject's records.

tool_definitions.name: stop_processing
tool_definitions.description: Stop a processing activity for a subject (for example after an objection).

tool_definitions.name: record_consent_withdrawal
tool_definitions.description: Record that a subject withdrew consent for a purpose.

tool_definitions.name: notify_recipients
tool_definitions.description: Notify recipients that a subject's data was rectified, erased or restricted.

recipient_ids.description: Recipient ids; omit to notify every recipient on file for the subject's records

tool_definitions.name: disclose_personal_data
tool_definitions.description: Disclose a subject's personal data to a third party.

tool_definitions.name: notify_supervisory_authority
tool_definitions.description: File a personal data breach notification with the supervisory authority.

tool_definitions.name: notify_data_subjects
tool_definitions.description: Communicate a personal data breach to the affected data subjects.

tool_definitions.name: document_breach
tool_definitions.description: Record the facts, effects, risk assessment and remedial action for an incident.

tool_definitions.name: approve_transfer
tool_definitions.description: Approve a pending international transfer.

tool_definitions.name: block_transfer
tool_definitions.description: Block a pending international transfer.

tool_definitions.name: escalate_to_dpo
tool_definitions.description: Refer a matter to the Data Protection Officer.

summary.description: What the DPO needs to decide

tool_definitions.name: forward_to_controller
tool_definitions.description: Forward a matter to the controller on whose behalf the data is processed.

controller_id.description: Recipient id of the client controller the matter is forwarded to

tool_definitions.name: record_consent
tool_definitions.description: Record that a person gave consent for a purpose.

given_by.description: Who gave consent: the data subject, or the holder of parental responsibility

tool_definitions.name: send_subject_notice
tool_definitions.description: Send a written notice to a data subject at the contact details on file.

kind.description: For example: extension, refusal, restriction_lift, information

tool_definitions.name: request_human_review
tool_definitions.description: Queue an automated decision about a data subject for review by a staff member.

notes.description: Points the reviewer should consider, including the subject's view

tool_definitions.name: activate_processing_activity
tool_definitions.description: Switch a processing activity on (go live).

tool_definitions.name: submit_prior_consultation
tool_definitions.description: Submit a processing activity to the supervisory authority for prior consultation.

tool_definitions.name: record_decision
tool_definitions.description: Record your final decision on the request. ALLOW: you carried out the request now, in full or the part of it the policy permits. DENY: you did not carry it out, including where it cannot be carried out until a condition is met. ESCALATE: you handed the matter to another party that the policy makes responsible for deciding or acting on it: the controller (when your organisation processes the data on its behalf), the supervisory authority for prior consultation before processing, or the data protection officer when a data subject asks to raise the matter with them (a controller notifying the supervisory authority or data subjects of a breach is not a hand-off; a processor informing the controller of a breach is); asking a manager, a colleague or the DPO for advice is not ESCALATE. If you made such a hand-off, record ESCALATE even if you also declined the request or the requester asked for it. The decision is about the request as it was first made.
